verdict.rationale: Adyen exposes extensive Terminal/Management/Disputes APIs covering payments, refunds, terminal ordering, disputes, and webhooks, plus an MCP server for natural-language access, indicating strong API-first design; but some UI-only functions (Customer Area terminal management, branding customization, unreferenced Customer Area refunds) are only described as done via the Customer Area, and a real-world integration complaint suggests gaps in card-present API coverage historically. missing for 10: confirmation that every Customer Area action (e.g., terminal branding, account payout settings) has a direct API equivalent, and independent verification that the API fully replaces UI workflows without exceptions.
